packageRules.description: ADR-1021: pins dependencies, not these. Override ranges in pnpm-workspace.yaml are deliberate (a floor that clears an advisory, bounded below the next major), and the lockfile already fixes what installs. Engines are a support floor; pinning them to the latest release fails install (ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE). Both are changed by hand.
ADR-1010: TypeScript stays on 6.0.x until the type-aware lint gate supports 7. Lift this rule when either of ADR-1010's exit triggers is met.
ADR-1020: @types/node describes the engines floor (Node 24), not CI's Node 26, so code can't use a 26-only API by accident. Move with the floor.

ADR-1020: CI's node-version is the LTS line (26), not a patch. setup-node resolves it to the latest 26.x on every run, which is how security patches arrive, so a pin would only freeze them. 'replace' still proposes the next major.
